subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493.
source_quote: 9th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: reward offer
fact: Errde offers 175 gold pieces of equipment from the armory as initial reward, with another 175 gold pieces upon success.
source_quote: I offer you 175 gold pieces of equipment from our armory. When you bring me Droki and the proof I need, then I will give you 175 more.

subject: duergar attendants
fact: Gartokkar is accompanied by several duergar, and later other duergar approach to see what is happening.
source_quote: I am Gartokkar Xundorn, and these are my Duergar. Just then, a few other Duergar approaches to see what is happening.

subject: stone guards
fact: Dorhun is flanked by Duergar armed with curious stone weapons, referred to as Stone Guards.
source_quote: The Stone Giant stares at Thorin... flanked by Duergar, armed with curious stone weapons. ...Stone Guards, you are to let them through.

subject: stone guards patrol
fact: A group of Duergar with curious stone weapons, identified as Stone Guards, approach Thorin.
source_quote: Thorin downs his Darklake Brewery Stout... sees a group of Duergar with curious stone weapons approaching.

subject: Gartokkar's title
fact: Gartokkar is the Custodian of the Flame and chief of the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: I am the Custodian of the Flame, the chief of the Keepers of the Flame, who tend to Themberchaud’s needs.

subject: West Cleft District
fact: Droki lives in the West Cleft District, where the Derro live.
source_quote: Droki. He lives in the West Cleft District, where the Derro live.

subject: offer expiration
fact: Gartokkar's offer expires tomorrow.
source_quote: The offer expires tomorrow.

subject: duergar patrol size
fact: Gartokkar is accompanied by his Duergar, and other Duergar approach to see what is happening.
source_quote: I am Gartokkar Xundorn, and these are my Duergar. Just then, a few other Duergar approaches to see what is happening.

subject: Overlake Hold
fact: The meeting takes place in the Overlake Hold, the local guard house.
source_quote: they are in the Overlake Hold, the local guard house.

subject: reward structure
fact: Errde offers 175 gold pieces upfront and another 175 gold pieces upon successful delivery of Droki and proof.
source_quote: I offer you 175 gold pieces of equipment from our armory. When you bring me Droki and the proof I need, then I will give you 175 more.

subject: Gartokkar's status
fact: Gartokkar is the chief of the Keepers of the Flame and one of the Deepking’s most prized advisors.
source_quote: We are the most prized of the Deepking’s advisors.

subject: Cairngorm Cavern
fact: Dorhun invites Thorin to visit him at Cairngorm Cavern before leaving the city.
source_quote: I ask you to visit me at Cairngorm Cavern before you leave the city.

subject: duergar stone weapon bearers
fact: Dorhun is flanked by Duergar armed with curious stone weapons, called Stone Guards.
source_quote: flanked by Duergar, armed with curious stone weapons. ...Stone Guards, you are to let them through.

subject: meeting with stone guards
fact: Errde invites them to her office for a friendly conversation in the Overlake Hold.
source_quote: I must ask that you come to my office so we can talk.

subject: corruption inquiry
fact: Errde seeks proof of corruption linked to Droki, the Council of Savants, and Clan Lairds.
source_quote: Droki is the key to uncovering that corruption. He is linked to the Council of Savants and maybe even elements of the Clan Lairds.

subject: Zalthir's observation
fact: Zalthir notices Gartokkar has four notches on his ears, which do not look self-inflicted.
source_quote: Zalthir immediately notices the scars on his ears, four notches that don’t look self-inflicted.

subject: Darklake Brewery
fact: Daz and his group arrive at the Darklake Brewery.
source_quote: Daz and his odd collection of travelers arrive at the Darklake Brewery.

subject: Blade Bazaar
fact: Daz and his group arrive at the Blade Bazaar before going to the Darklake Brewery.
source_quote: from just outside the Blade Bazaar, Daz and his odd collection of travelers arrive at the Darklake Brewery.

subject: drow and halfling pair
fact: A Drow and a Halfling are drinking beer outside the Darklake Brewery.
source_quote: Just outside is a Drow and Halfing, and they are drinking beer.
